Ava (Design): Quick design check — segmented toggle in the dashboard (compact mode). Noticed a few things: 1) press target feels pretty small on mobile (<44px), 2) focus ring overlaps the rounded container edge when focused, 3) copy for the right-hand option: 'Metrics' vs 'Metrics view' — which is clearer? Thoughts? Mike (Frontend): Yep saw it in the staging build. Visual size is fine but hit area is ~34px. We can preserve visual compactness and increase hit target with extra padding via pseudo padding. Jasmin (PM): From product POV users sometimes get confused which view is active. 'Metrics view' is more explicit but takes more horizontal space. We have tight nav real estate. Oliver (A11y): A couple accessibility notes: segmented controls should expose tab semantics and state. Use role="tablist" + role="tab" and aria-selected. Also ensure focus ring has enough contrast and doesn't clip. Example: ```html
``` Also bump touch target to 44px minimum (44x44) per guidelines. Mike (Frontend): Good call. We can keep visual 32px height but add 6px vertical padding (hit area 44px) and use negative margin to maintain layout. For focus clipping I'll add outline-offset: 2px and increase border-radius clip by 1px. Ava (Design): Nice — can we also try a subtle inner shadow on the selected pill to separate it from container when compact? Keeps overall height but improves affordance. Mike (Frontend): Will prototype both: (A) increased hit area + outline-offset, (B) inner shadow on selected pill. I'll post screenshots. design-bot: screenshot uploaded: https://files.redwood/snap/segmented-proto-1.png Ava (Design): Screenshot looks promising. Shadow option reads heavier on the dark theme — maybe reduce opacity to 12%. Oliver (A11y): For keyboard users, ensure arrow key navigation (Left/Right) moves focus between tabs and updates aria-selected. Also announce state change with live region not necessary if we use aria-selected+role=tab. Jasmin (PM): Decision tradeoff: use shorter label + tooltip on hover in constrained layouts. For mobile show full label. Agree? Ava (Design): Fine by me. Proposal: keep default label 'Metrics' for compact nav, use 'Metrics view' on wider screens or when space allows. Add tooltip copy: "Switch to metrics view". Mike (Frontend): I'll implement responsive label with CSS clamp and add tooltip component. Plan: branch seg-toggle-hitbox-1845. Oliver (A11y): I'll review the PR for aria/key handling and do a quick keyboard/a11y checklist: role semantics, arrow nav, focus ring contrast, touch target sizing. Ava (Design): Action items: 1) @Mike implement prototypes + PR, 2) @Oliver review a11y, 3) @Ava write copy for tooltip and mobile label. I'll file the ticket and attach link to this thread. :thumbsup: Mike (Frontend): sounds good. ETA for PR: EOD Wednesday. Jasmin (PM): I'll add a quick UXR session item — 5 users on iPhone SE and a pixel to confirm hit targets. Ava (Design): Thanks all — closing this thread once PR is merged.
